summary: English and Uzbek first-party discovery identified the Cadastre Agency's National Geoinformation Portal and an Oltiariq district cadastral-office context. The portal advertises coordinate and cadastral-number search and Esri-backed mapping, but direct portal and related ArcGIS REST requests timed out; the State Urban Cadastre host returned 403. No anonymous safe parcel ID-plus-geometry response was qualified and no sample was retained.
queryAndRequestOutcomes: All executed discovery queries, URLs, direct requests, response outcomes, schema/CRS checks, safe field allowlist, scope limits, and uncertainty are recorded in city-4480-oltiariq.json. No login, CAPTCHA/Cloudflare bypass, credentials, private tokens, TLS bypass, or unsafe-field request occurred.

custodians.name: Cadastre Agency of the Republic of Uzbekistan / National Geoinformation Portal
custodians.scope: National cadastral and real-estate-rights information custodian; official Digital Government material describes the portal's open real-estate-register information service.

safeFieldAllowlist: stable native cadastral parcel identifier only if source-proven
full parcel polygon geometry only when safely returned
scopeLimits: The exact WUP point and population are preserved in the city record.
Portal timeout, REST timeout, and 403 outcomes are access/qualification results, not evidence of parcel absence.
No anonymous ID-plus-geometry response, parcel schema, CRS, or citywide vector coverage was qualified.
No unsafe land-record fields were requested or retained.
Packet completion is not source integration/admission.
uncertainty: A current portal client configuration or authenticated workflow may expose further services, but no credentials or login were used.
The relationship between the indexed ArcGIS REST catalog and current portal availability could not be verified because both live requests timed out.
No independent runtime adapter qualification was performed.
